description: R/terra end-to-end execution was not available in the build environment
mitigation: Run validation/run_all_tests.R --synthetic and a real-raster smoke run in the target R environment.

description: Pure-R per-pixel bootstrap can be computationally prohibitive for large detected masks
mitigation: Use max_target_pixels preflight; benchmark target data; vectorize/Rcpp before full-scale analysis if necessary

description: Linear-residual rho can confound structural breaks with serial correlation; inference can be sensitive to the temporal-dependence model.
mitigation: Retain the specified hinge-residual corrected primary rho; inspect exact linear_diagnostic sensitivity and report its limits without post-hoc estimator switching.

description: Primary null/bootstrap assumes stationary homoscedastic Gaussian AR(1) errors
mitigation: Use residual diagnostics; add innovation/heteroskedastic sensitivity if diagnostics fail

description: Finite Monte Carlo resolution can constrain small p values and the BH cutoff.
mitigation: Check per-response B, p-value floor and FDR cutoff in each new run; historical clearance does not transfer to new data.

description: Cell-center polygon assignment approximates partial boundary-cell coverage and cannot represent overlapping zones simultaneously
mitigation: Verify regions are non-overlapping and boundary approximation is negligible or replace with exact fractional polygon weights

description: Block jackknife deletes detected cells from aggregate break-year summaries; it does not rerun pixel inference
mitigation: Interpret only as aggregate spatial-sampling stability

description: Adjusted IoU independence baseline ignores spatial autocorrelation
mitigation: Report raw/expected/adjusted IoU and treat adjusted IoU as descriptive

description: Uniform candidate-year ratio is not a null distribution for estimated break years
mitigation: Label as descriptive reference only; rely on scenario comparisons and simulations for inference

description: A single full-series SupF null is invalid for arbitrary missing-year patterns
mitigation: Complete-series inference is enforced; synthetic missing-year cells are explicit regression tests; missing-pattern calibration is unsupported

description: Pixel bootstrap is run only for primary recovery pixels and intervals are conditional on recovery replicates
mitigation: Use stability terminology; do not interpret as unconditional probability or population coverage

description: Metric block deletion is invalid if projected coordinates are not metres
mitigation: Code requires Cartesian metre units in the CRS WKT

description: A regional mean can mix subregions with different break years; the aggregate trajectory can violate a single-hinge + AR(1) model and create apparent residual persistence
mitigation: Treat regional inference as secondary; inspect residual/rho-bound warnings; compare against region-level pixel break distributions; consider flexible descriptive trends if heterogeneity is strong

description: High recovery-mask IoU can coexist with materially shifted break years across boundary scenarios
mitigation: Scenario output now reports exact/±1-year break agreement and mean/median absolute year shift separately from IoU

description: Best-hinge rho bias mapping is computationally heavier than linear mapping
mitigation: Bias mappings are cached with code/RNG/grid/B/R-version keys; benchmark first construction and reuse cache

description: PSOCK workers multiply R-process memory and can create competing GeoTIFF reads, so maximum core count may not be fastest or memory-safe
mitigation: Use runtime.parallel.max_workers/MAX_CORES; BLAS threads are capped at one; benchmark wall time/peak RAM/disk throughput on target hardware

description: Parallel scheduling must not change Monte Carlo or pixel-bootstrap random realizations
mitigation: MC uses chunk-key seeds and pixel bootstrap uses response+cell-key seeds; parallel_reproducibility.R tests serial-vs-PSOCK/order invariance but still requires execution in an R environment

description: Interrupted parallel work could leave a partial calibration cache
mitigation: RDS caches use temporary-file+rename and unreadable caches are deleted/recomputed
